fullDescription: A clean monochrome editorial social feed: white ground, near-black ink, one crisp cobalt accent; a stories/avatars row, text-forward post cards (with an optional dark media card), and a bottom tab bar with a cobalt compose FAB.

structured.summary: A clean, editorial MONOCHROME mobile social feed: a top app bar with logo + search + compose, a horizontal stories/avatars row, a scroll of post cards (avatar + handle + verified tick, a typographic post, an optional dark 'case study' media card or link-preview, and like/comment/share/bookmark actions), and a bottom tab bar with a cobalt compose FAB. Restraint reads louder than colour — text-forward and confident.

style.description: Clean mono minimal: white/off-white + near-black ink + greys, ONE crisp cobalt accent.
style.prompt: Monochrome editorial. White / off-white ground, near-black ink text, a calm grey hierarchy for secondary text/dividers, and ONE crisp cobalt accent (used sparingly: the compose FAB, verified ticks, the active bookmark, a link). Generous whitespace, hairline separators, strong typographic hierarchy (a clean grotesque). Media cards are dark/neutral, not colourful. No gradients, no slop-indigo-as-decoration — cobalt is a deliberate single accent.

layout_and_structure.description: Single mobile feed, vertical: top app bar, stories row, post cards, bottom tab bar with center FAB.

prompts.prompt: A logo mark + wordmark on the left; a search icon and a compose/new icon on the right.
A horizontal row of circular avatars (first = 'You' with a + ring), names beneath, scrollable.

A card: avatar + display name + verified tick + @handle + relative time + a '...' menu; a typographic post (a quote/statement reads well in mono); an optional dark media card (e.g. a 'CASE STUDY' tile) or a link-preview row; an actions row (like + count, comment + count, share, and a right-aligned bookmark).
A vertical scroll of 2-3 distinct post cards (text-only, media, and link-preview variants) so the pattern's range is visible.
A bottom tab bar (Home active, Explore, Alerts, Profile) with a raised CENTER cobalt compose FAB (+).

special_ui_components.prompt: A white card with ink text, a hairline divider, an actions row; colour is reserved (cobalt) for verified ticks / active states only.
A raised circular cobalt '+' button breaking the bottom tab bar's center.

structured.special_notes: Mobile PHONE form factor (~390px) with a bottom tab bar — NOT a desktop/tablet sidebar. Cobalt is the only colour; everything else mono. Responsive at 360/768.
